frames.visible_job: The concrete drawing job this frame performs.
Darkens, colors, shades, cleans, or clarifies elements from an earlier frame.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens, shades, colors, or clarifies elements that were already introduced.

rejection_checks: No major contour, prop, marking, or color choice should first appear in the final image.
No frame may darken, ink, color, shade, or clean a feature that was not already visible in an earlier frame.
Once a major element appears, it must remain visible in every later frame unless a documented physical overlap hides it.
No keeper line may be removed to make room for a later foreground element; reserve that foreground footprint first.
No adjacent frame should look unchanged at card size.
The final image must keep the same pose, scale, and placement as the step frames.
